overview_description.description:
Dbt Labs is a developer of an open-source analytics engineering tool driven by a mission to help analysts create and disseminate organizational knowledge. Its platform enables data analysts to easily create and disseminate organizational knowledge through data modeling, thereby allowing clients with SQL knowledge to build data transformation workflows.

The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

about_short_description.short_description: dbt Labs is a data analytics software company that develops tools for transforming and managing data within cloud data warehouses.

product.name: dbt Platform
product.description: A data transformation platform for developing, testing, documenting, deploying, and governing SQL-based data pipelines in cloud data warehouses.

product.name: dbt Core
product.description: An open-source command-line framework for transforming data in warehouses with SQL, using modular models, testing, documentation, and version control.

product.name: dbt Catalog
product.description: A metadata and lineage product that helps teams discover, understand, document, and govern data models and their dependencies.

product.name: dbt Semantic Layer
product.description: A semantic modeling capability that centralizes business definitions and makes governed metrics available for consistent analysis across data and analytics tools.

product.name: dbt Professional Services
product.description: Consulting and implementation services that help organizations deploy, scale, and optimize dbt-based analytics engineering and data transformation programs.
